mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_rating( receiver_user_id, evaluator_user_id, score, match_id, match_type, created_at ) VALUES ( #{receiverUserId}, #{evaluatorUserId}, #{score}, #{matchId}, #{matchType}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 1) AS avgScore, COUNT(*) AS ratingCount FROM user_rating WHERE receiver_user_id = #{userId}
